clips.title: The story
paras: In Duskwood, Sven's ruined farm holds a dirt-stained journal with no title. Its fragments record an unknown onlooker's glimpse of the attack on Sven Yorgen's family.

A loose mound of dirt among the charred remains of Sven's farm in southern Duskwood hides a weather-damaged journal. Its anonymous writer left frantic, incomplete notes about the tragedy at the homestead. The pages support Sven Yorgen's suspicion that someone watched from the shadows while his family was slain. The account breaks off without explaining who the writer was or what happened next. Sven's clue leads investigators to carry the book to Darkshire, hoping someone there will recognize the handwriting.
